title: Hush
paste.tooltip: Opens a private prompt for the value
hint.default: Agents get a private file path, never the value.
hint.replace: %1 exists. Pasting replaces its value; canceling keeps it.
hint.waiting: A paste prompt is open. Finish it first.
status.reference: Note for %1 copied. Paste it into your agent chat.
status.value: Value of %1 copied. The clipboard keeps it for 30 seconds.
status.saveFailed: Could not save %1. Run hush set %1 for details.
status.actionFailed: That did not work. Run hush list for details.
status.listFailed: Could not read secrets. Run hush list for details.
confirm.forget: Click again or press Delete to forget %1.
confirm.clear: Click Confirm to forget every secret.
empty.title: No secrets yet
empty.body: When an agent needs one, a paste prompt opens for you.
row.reference.tooltip: Copies a note naming %1 for your agent chat, never the value
row.value.tooltip: Copy value (C). Avoid pasting it into chats.
help.agents: Agents request secrets by name with hush request NAME. You only paste into the prompt.
help.reference: Copy for agent copies a short note with the name. Use it to point an agent at a secret you added.
help.value: Copy value puts the real secret on the clipboard for 30 seconds.
help.storage: Values stay in private temporary files and are removed after 24 hours, at logout, or on reboot.
help.keys: ↑ ↓ select · Enter copy for agent · C copy value · Delete forget · / name
help.setup: Copy setup text for another agent
